question: Which of the following valleys is NOT located in Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silent Valley**__.

__
 
• **Silent Valley is NOT located in Himachal Pradesh**__. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Silent Valley National park** is located in Kerala.

 
 
• It is located in Niligiri Hills.
 
• It is located in the Palakkad district of Kerala and the Niligiri district of Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kuntipuzha river** drains for 15 km in the park from north to south.
 
• Mudugar and Irula tribal are indigenous people.
 
 
 
• **The Chumbi Valley**, called Dromo or Tromo in Tibetan, is a valley in the Himalayas that projects southwards from the Tibetan plateau, intervening between Sikkim and Bhutan.
 
• **Malana** is an ancient Indian village in the state of Himachal Pradesh.
